subject: Renewal & Capacity uplift — kickoff, timeline, and QBR slot proposal
summary: Kickoff for BrightLoop renewal (term shift + capacity uplift). Propose QBR dates, align stakeholders (product, procurement, legal), and circulate mutual action plan and pricing artifacts. Next steps: confirm QBR slot, procurement timeline, and pre-QBR technical dry-run.
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@brightloop.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal & Capacity uplift — kickoff, timeline, and QBR slot proposal

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As discussed, BrightLoop is approaching the 12/15 renewal window and we want to get a short kickoff in motion so we have clear milestones for term changes and the proposed throughput uplift. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm whether you want to move to an annual term (vs current 6-mo) and target effective date.
- Confirm expected steady-state throughput (rps / daily token volumes) so we can size Dedicated capacity and provide a firm price uplift.
- Lock a QBR/handshake meeting in the next 2–3 weeks to align execs and engineering.

Proposed QBR slots (all PDT):
1) Wed, Sep 8 — 09:00–10:00
2) Thu, Sep 9 — 14:00–15:00

I've attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) to this thread to capture milestones (legal, procurement, SSO/KMS items, dry-run, and target go-live). Can you confirm the stakeholders you want in the QBR (CTO / Procurement / Finance)? Also, if procurement has any calendar constraints or PO lead times, flag those now so we can bake them into the timeline.

Attachments: [Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Proposed next steps:
1) You pick a QBR slot from above.
2) BrightLoop confirms procurement and technical stakeholders.
3) Redwood returns a capacity readout + price delta within 3 business days.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on the runway.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Morris <elena@brightloop.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Carlos Vega <carlos.vega@brightloop.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightloop.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & Capacity uplift — kickoff, timeline, and QBR slot proposal

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the MAP and the clear options. We are aligned with the idea of moving to an annual term (finance prefers annual for budgeting) — target renewal effective date 2026-12-15.

Stakeholders to include in the QBR:
- Carlos Vega, CTO (engineering & infra)
- Priya Shah, Procurement (PO / timing)
- Me (Elena) — renewal owner

Carlos and Priya are looped above. Priya — FYI: typical PO processing is ~3 weeks but finance may need longer if this touches a new vendor contract.

Both proposed slots look plausible. Carlos is tight on mornings next week but Sep 9 at 14:00 PDT works for him. If Redwood can provide a short capacity readout and a pricing summary before then, that will help the QBR be actionable. Also please include an expected procurement path (who we sign with / SOW vs PO).

Thanks — we’ll tentatively take Thu, Sep 9 14:00 PDT.

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & Capacity uplift — kickoff, timeline, and QBR slot proposal

Elena / Carlos / Priya —

Thanks, Sep 9 at 14:00 PDT is locked on our side. Ben and Marissa are looped to help with procurement timing and contract items. A few quick items before the QBR so we can make it a 45-min, decision-focused meeting:

1) Capacity & price delta — attached is a 2-page capacity readout and the preliminary pricing uplift (token-based + reserved GPU delta). That doc has a conservative cushion; we’ll refine post dry-run. [Attachment: brightloop_capacity_readout.pdf] [Attachment: pricing_uplift_summary.pdf]

2) Procurement path — Ben: please confirm whether we should route via SOW (preferred for multi-quarter pilots) vs standard PO. Ben, can you add expected lead times for both?

3) Legal review — Marissa: I’ve flagged two contract items in the MAP (data retention and audit window). If we can get legal redlines by 09/02 we’ll incorporate them into the QBR materials.

4) Pre-QBR tech dry-run — recommended: Sep 7, 11:00 PDT (30 min) with Carlos and a Redwood infra engineer to validate load patterns and KV-cache behavior on Dedicated. Please confirm availability.

Action items (short):
- BrightLoop: confirm PO timeline and availability for dry-run (Priya / Carlos).
- Redwood: finalize the MAP and pricing snapshot, and circulate final QBR deck by EOD 09/03.

Attachments: [Attachment: brightloop_capacity_readout.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: pricing_uplift_summary.pdf (PDF)]

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal & Capacity uplift — kickoff, timeline, and QBR slot proposal

Perfect — Sep 9 14:00 PDT confirmed.

Priya: procurement will use a standard PO for the uplift; lead time is ~3 weeks. I attached our internal PO workflow so Redwood can see touchpoints. (Ben: please confirm if Redwood needs a vendor packet or vendor setup form.)

Carlos: Sep 7 at 11:00 PDT for the dry-run works for us.

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Looking forward to the QBR and the updated MAP / pricing on 09/03.

Attachments: [Attachment: brightloop_po_process.docx (document)]

—
Elena Morris
Head of Customer Success, BrightLoop
elena@brightloop.com
